name: Chloé Ridel - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on addressing transnational repression of human rights defenders
part_text:
Some governments reach beyond their own borders to silence people who defend human rights abroad. This report names that practice "transnational repression" and asks the European Union to fight it. It wants a shared definition, protection for people at risk, including emergency help and visas, rules on spyware and social media, and sanctions against those responsible. The report is the Parliament's opinion and request; it does not itself change any law.

- The report asks for EU protection, monitoring and sanctions; no law changes yet.
- It affects human rights defenders, journalists and exiles, including in the EU.
- Next, the Commission and EU countries decide whether to act on these requests.
